summary: Tested Data & Privacy settings feature. Fixed critical bug in backend service where soft-deleted records caused unique constraint violations. All 23 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified working - all CRUD operations, CSV export, and Reset to Global functionality work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in privacy-settings.service.ts: upsertEventSettings was failing when trying to create new settings after a reset because soft-deleted records still existed with the same event_id. The fix now checks for ANY existing record (including soft-deleted) and restores it instead of trying to insert a new one.
seed_data_creation: Event 1 has privacy settings configured. Global default settings exist with event_id=null.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data & Privacy settings feature fully working. Key features verified: 1) GET /api/events/{eventId}/privacy-settings - returns settings with global fallback, 2) PUT /api/events/{eventId}/privacy-settings - updates event-specific settings (fixed bug with soft-deleted records), 3) POST /api/events/{eventId}/privacy-settings/reset - resets to global defaults, 4) GET /api/events/{eventId}/privacy-settings/export - exports full event data as CSV. Frontend: Settings > Data & Privacy page shows GDPR toggle, Cookie Consent toggle, Privacy Policy URL input, Data Retention dropdown (90/180/365/forever), Custom Consent Text textarea, Download CSV button, Reset to Global button, Save Changes button. All UI elements have data-testid attributes for testing.

bug_fixed.description: Fixed unique constraint violation when updating privacy settings after reset
bug_fixed.root_cause: The upsertEventSettings method was checking for existing records with is_deleted=false, but after a reset (which soft-deletes the record), it would try to INSERT a new record. This failed because the unique constraint on event_id doesn't account for soft-deleted records.
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Modified upsertEventSettings to check for ANY existing record (including soft-deleted) and update/restore it instead of inserting a new one. Added is_deleted: false to the update data to restore soft-deleted records.
